questions.question: Explain the principal of division of work as explained by Henri Fayol
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. Henri Fayol's principle of division of work states that tasks should be divided among
  • individuals or groups based on their skills and expertise. This specialization increases
  • efficiency, improves performance, and enhances productivity by enabling workers to focus

questions.question: Define sports Management
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. Sports Management is the field of business that deals with planning, organizing
  • directing, controlling, and overseeing various aspects of the sports industry. It involves the
  • application of management principles to sports organizations, teams, events, facilities, and
  • athletes
questions.final_answer: athletes

questions.question: How do fans serve as key stakeholders in sports management?
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. Fans are key stakeholders in sports management because they drive revenue through
  • ticket sales, merchandise, and viewership, which attract sponsorships and media deals.
  • Their loyalty and engagement directly influence a team's reputation, success, and long-term
  • sustainability. Effective management must prioritize fan experience and satisfaction to
  • maintain and grow support.
questions.final_answer: maintain and grow support

questions.question: Explain the scope of management
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. The scope of management covers key functions such as planning, organizing, staffing
  • directing, controlling, coordinating, decision-making, and managing innovation. These
  • functions ensure that resources are used efficiently to achieve organizational goals.
  • Management applies at various levels of an organization and adapts to changing needs
  • from strategy development to daily operations.

questions.question: Explain the function of FIFA in global sports
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association) is the global governing body
  • for soccer (football). Its functions include organizing international competitions like the FIFA
  • World Cup, setting global rules and standards for the sport, overseeing rankings, promoting
  • soccer development worldwide, and ensuring fair play and integrity in the game. FIFA also
  • works with member associations to grow the sport and increase its reach across all
  • continents.
questions.final_answer: continents
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) Regular Exam Sem 1, Nov 2024

questions.question: Explain the role of sponsors in sports management
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. Sponsors play a crucial role in sports management by providing financial support
  • resources, and promotional opportunities. They help fund events, teams, or athletes
  • enhancing the sport's reach and visibility. In return, sponsors gain brand exposure
  • marketing opportunities, and alignment with popular events or figures. Sponsorships
  • contribute to the growth and sustainability of sports organizations and events, benefiting both
  • sponsors and the sports industry.
questions.final_answer: sponsors and the sports industry
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) Regular Exam Sem 1, Nov 2024

questions.question: Explain the scope of management
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. The scope of management covers key functions such as planning, organizing, staffing
  • directing, controlling, coordinating, decision-making, and managing innovation. These
  • functions ensure that resources are used efficiently to achieve organizational goals.
  • Management applies at various levels of an organization and adapts to changing needs
  • from strategy development to daily operations.
questions.final_answer: from strategy development to daily operations
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) Regular Exam Sem 1, Nov 2024

questions.question: Explain the function of FIFA in global sports
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association) is the global governing body
  • for soccer (football). Its functions include organizing international competitions like the FIFA
  • World Cup, setting global rules and standards for the sport, overseeing rankings, promoting
  • soccer development worldwide, and ensuring fair play and integrity in the game. FIFA also
  • works with member associations to grow the sport and increase its reach across all
  • continents.
questions.final_answer: continents
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) Regular Exam Sem 1, Nov 2024

questions.question: Explain the role of sponsors in sports management
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. Sponsors play a crucial role in sports management by providing financial support
  • resources, and promotional opportunities. They help fund events, teams, or athletes
  • enhancing the sport's reach and visibility. In return, sponsors gain brand exposure
  • marketing opportunities, and alignment with popular events or figures. Sponsorships
  • contribute to the growth and sustainability of sports organizations and events, benefiting both
  • sponsors and the sports industry.
questions.final_answer: sponsors and the sports industry
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) Regular Exam Sem 1, Nov 2024

questions.question: Explain how controlling help in achieving organisational goals
questions.solution_html:
• Ans. Controlling helps achieve organizational goals by monitoring performance, identifying
  • deviations from the plan, and taking corrective actions to stay on track. It ensures resources
  • are used efficiently, improves decision-making, and promotes continuous improvement
  • keeping the organization aligned with its objectives.
questions.final_answer: keeping the organization aligned with its objectives
